tonight.headline: Coker went elsewhere; the lineup is already right
body: Bad news first. Bhayshul Tuten has missed two straight practices with the ankle and foot (Yahoo, 4 Nov) and plays Thursday night at Baltimore. Kyler Murray's hamstring is still undecided for Monday; Carson Wentz throws to Jefferson if he sits. And the Coker claim did not land — Nicky Jam have him.

Overnight the owner's claims put Etienne (on IR) in for Hockenson and Allgeier in for Bass. The lineup as set is now exactly the projection lineup, 123.6 against Talla Metralla's 130.1. The only thing left to decide is Thursday's Tuten check at 17:45.

case.label: Where the points are
case.body: ESPN gives AVIATO 47%. Nothing on the bench beats a starter by more than a coin flip, so the 6.5-point gap is roster, not lineup.

case.label: Their week
case.body: Talla Metralla start Burrow in Madrid (08:30 CDMX Sunday) and Derrick Henry at Baltimore on Thursday, where the Ravens start third-string rookie Joe Fagnano (CBS 3 Nov). Michael Wilson (broken ribs) now sits on their bench.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The projection lineup is set and AVIATO still trail by more than 10 after Sunday's early games — then the gap was roster, not lineup.

case.label: The injury
case.body: Ankle/foot from Week 8 — he played through it. DNP Monday (DK Network 3 Nov) and missed Tuesday too (Yahoo, 4 Nov 01:55Z). Rodriguez (hand) was limited both days.

case.label: The fallback
case.body: Kamara 11.2 is the best eligible bench back. Allgeier, claimed overnight, projects 9.3 as Arizona's lead back with Love on IR — 1.9 behind, a coin flip, so the projection picks Kamara.

case.label: If he is active
case.body: Leave him in. 15.4 against 11.2 is a real gap and a questionable tag is a label, not a probability.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tuten is active and Kamara would have outscored him (archive) — the contingency only fires on an inactive.

whatWentWrong.title: Coker went to Nicky Jam; two backs came in instead
whatWentWrong.lead: Nicky Jam's claim for Coker processed at 09:03Z; AVIATO's processed for Etienne and Allgeier, dropping Hockenson and Bass.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Activity log 4 Nov 09:03Z: AVIATO add Etienne (drop Hockenson) and Allgeier (drop Bass); Nicky Jam add Coker. Whether AVIATO also claimed Coker is invisible — ESPN shows only processed moves.

case.label: What it costs
case.body: Etienne is on IR and Chem has no IR slot, so a bench seat carries 0.0 until his window opens (targeted for today, SI 2 Nov). Allgeier is a real back — Arizona's lead for four-plus weeks (FFB ~3 Nov) — and gives the Tuten card a second option.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Coker, now on Nicky Jam, outscores AVIATO's lowest-scoring started receiver in two of Weeks 9-11 (archive) — the standing test of the 28 Oct drop.

worthALook.name: Giants D/ST
worthALook.lead: At Philadelphia against Tanner McKee — 1.3 better than the Commanders, not enough yet.

case.label: The matchup
case.body: Hurts on IR, expected out for the season; McKee starts (Inquirer 4 Nov; DK 3 Nov). 7.5 projected. Broncos D/ST 7.7, at Carolina, is the top free agent.

case.label: Why not now
case.body: 7.5 against 6.2 is 1.3 — STRATEGY §5 wants a real gap. The Commanders slot changed hands 28 Oct and opens to the churn rule tomorrow; Stafford (elbow) is expected to play for the Rams (Forbes 4 Nov).

case.label: When to act
case.body: If the Rams' Thursday report has Stafford limited again and Washington's implied total holds, hold. If a second Commanders starter is ruled out, swap as a free agent — no claim.
